title: A genus-three hyperelliptic curve with rational Jacobian three-torsion of rank three
summary: An explicit hyperelliptic genus-three curve has rational Jacobian three-torsion (Z/3)^3; dual degree-2^9 isogenies give three-primary Selmer and Sha transfer on every quadratic twist.
abstract: We exhibit a hyperelliptic curve of genus three over the rationals whose Jacobian has rational three-torsion isomorphic to \((\Z/3\Z)^3\). This supplies the genus-three example asked for by Levin, Yan and Wiljanen. The curve is a double cover of a rational conic with two commuting sign involutions. Three explicit maps of degree eight to elliptic curves with rational points of order three produce independent torsion classes; the Weil pairing gives the matching upper bound. Pullback and pushforward give dual isogenies of degree \(2^9\). Consequently, for every quadratic twist and every \(n\geq1\), its \(3^n\)-Selmer group and \(3^n\)-torsion in the Tate--Shafarevich group identify with those of the product of the three elliptic twists, without a finiteness assumption.
